prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1225; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I was going through on a green light when another car came in from the side.

Q: Which direction were you traveling?

A: I was heading straight through the intersection. The other vehicle was coming from my right and didn't stop for its red light, as far as I could tell.

Q: Did you have any time to react?

A: Not really. I saw the car at the last second and braked, but it hit the passenger side of my vehicle before I could do much.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side curtain airbag came out, I think. Everything happened so fast.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or emergency room afterward?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some physical therapy referrals.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially in the morning, and I get headaches when I turn my head quickly. I've been missing some work because of it.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this accident?

A: Not that I'm aware of. I had no real issues before.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping this gets resolved so I can recover properly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
